thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3387654321 — Praxis VPC (dedicated pool p-ded-45) — elevated 5xx rate detected. Affected tenant: praxis-corp. Paging oncall. Severity: high.

maria-oncall: I’m on it. Seeing spike ~02:03 UTC, 5xx rate from that pool jumped to ~18%. Traces show backend timeout + connection resets.

kai-eng: grabbing logs from pool p-ded-45 now. preliminary: a small subset of worker VMs producing OOMs then restart loop. Could be model-serving process leak or new model rollout.

maria-oncall: tagging @alex-cs to alert Praxis customer-facing. Alex, are they on an active request right now?

alex-cs: yup they’re in the middle of a scheduled batch scoring window. Notified customer ops that we’re investigating. They’re sensitive to latency and will want ETA for mitigation.

elaine-sre: I’m taking lead on mitigation. First action: isolate praxis-corp traffic away from p-ded-45 to prevent cascading. Plan: create temporary routing to p-ded-45-standby pool (p-standby-3). If standby capacity insufficient, spin ephemeral nodes in dedicated burst pool.

sam-ops: standby has 2 nodes free. I can spin 4 ephemeral nodes in the burst pool and attach to a new pool. Running command now: 

```
redwoodctl pools create --name p-temp-praxis --type dedicated --nodes 4 --region us-west-2
redwoodctl pools attach-tenant --tenant praxis-corp --pool p-temp-praxis
```

sam-ops: pool created and tenant attached. Traffic should be routing in ~45s based on LB healthchecks.

maria-oncall: monitoring. 1m: error rate for praxis-corp down 60% from peak. Good. Still seeing intermittent 502s from older requests pinned to p-ded-45 KV cache.

kai-eng: digging into crashed worker logs — snippet: 

```
[2026-03-15T02:02:48Z] model-server[pid=2145]: ERROR memory allocation failed: cannot allocate 256MB
[2026-03-15T02:02:49Z] kernel: oom-killer invoked: killing process 2145 (model-server)
```

elaine-sre: looks like an out-of-memory regression. Was there a recent quantized model rollout to that pool? @jordan-platform?

jordan-platform: yes, we rolled model v2.3-qopt to p-ded-45 at 01:58 UTC as part of a staged rollout. Can confirm the rollout targeted that dedicated pool.

ryan-eng: if v2.3-qopt is the cause we should rollback that variant for praxis-corp only. We can pin customer to v2.2-stable or the new temp pool with v2.2.

elaine-sre: agreed. Immediate fix: pin praxis-corp to v2.2-stable and remove v2.3-qopt from p-ded-45 for other tenants until we patch memory leak. Command: 

```
redwoodctl tenants pin --tenant praxis-corp --model v2.2-stable --pool p-temp-praxis
redwoodctl rollout cancel --model v2.3-qopt --pool p-ded-45
```

sam-ops: executed both. Praxis traffic now fully on p-temp-praxis and pinned to v2.2-stable. Error rate at 02:08 UTC back to baseline.

maria-oncall: handing ops to @elaine-sre for root cause and long-term mitigation. I’ll stay on watch for 30m and then go into sleep rotation.

elaine-sre: taking over. Next steps: reproduce locally against a replica of v2.3-qopt to confirm leak. Also schedule hotfix build.

alex-cs: drafting customer comms. Proposed message: 

"Hi Praxis team — we observed elevated 5xx errors between 02:00–02:10 UTC impacting your batch scoring. We isolated your traffic to a temporary dedicated pool and pinned you to v2.2-stable; this restored service. We identified a memory regression in the v2.3-qopt model; we have rolled back that rollout while we build a patch. We’ll follow up with an RCA and offer 10% credit for the affected billing window. ETA for RCA draft: 48 hours. Apologies for the disruption. — Alex, Customer Success"

alex-cs: need quick ack from eng/SRE on the rollback wording and proposed credit.

ryan-eng: wording looks fine. Need to confirm credit amount with finance but 10% month credit for incident window is reasonable for this scale.

jordan-platform: RCA owners: @elaine-sre + @kai-eng. Timeline: initial RCA draft in 48 hours, full RCA + mitigations in 7 days.

elaine-sre: assigned. I’ll include root cause (model regression introduced by v2.3-qopt memory allocation change), list of short-term mitigations (tenant pinning, rollout guardrails), and long-term fixes (add memory regression tests to rollout pipeline, enforce per-process memory cgroup).

sam-ops: follow-ups: 1) add ephemeral pool warmup to our runbook 2) add rollout-canary quota for dedicated pools 3) schedule replay test for praxis traces on patched model.

maria-oncall: thanks team. I’ll update the incident ticket and mark mitigation state -> recovered. Leaving this thread for RCA tracking.

incident-bot: Incident 3387654321 status changed: MITIGATED at 02:12 UTC. Owner: elaine-sre. RCA draft due: 2026-03-17T02:00:00Z. Follow-up meeting scheduled: 2026-03-16T15:00 UTC (invite sent).

alex-cs: sending customer update now (will paste final copy here).

ryan-eng: thumbs for credit amount and timeline. Also recommend we run a scan of other pools where v2.3-qopt rolled out.

jordan-platform: noted. I’ll add scanning job to platform backlog and prioritize.

elaine-sre: final note — we should consider adding an automatic rollback policy on memory OOM detection for model rollouts to avoid manual intervention next time. Filing as action item in RCA.
